sources.entry: Glif - Build AI mini-apps and chatbots using LLMs. #freemium

summary.name: Glif
summary.one_liner: Glif is an AI creative agent that generates images, videos, and audio from a single chat prompt, choosing the underlying models itself.
keywords: all in one ai media tool
use_cases: Build a product campaign with films, photos and posters
Swap a dress onto a model photo and animate it
Generate matching scenes for a lookbook
Use creative AI tools from inside Claude, Cursor or Codex
summary.what_it_does: Glif takes a natural-language brief and selects models across image, video, audio, and language to produce the assets. The page demos include product photography, a 16:9 campaign film with soundscape, a 9:16 launch film, and a 1:1 hero still. It can edit an existing photo (such as swapping a garment), animate it with a video model, generate additional matching scenes, and stitch them into a final cut. A project context keeps user references across assets so later outputs stay consistent. Glif can also be connected to other agents such as Claude, Cursor, Codex, and VS Code.
notable: One chat prompt routes work across image, video, and audio models automatically
Project-level references keep visual consistency across many generated assets
Can be used from other AI agents like Claude, Cursor, and Codex
Includes tools to evaluate which model output is better design
caveats: The page says 'Free to start', which implies paid tiers exist, but no prices or limits are listed
Available platforms beyond the web app are not specified on the page
